title: ISS EVA Planning — Quiet Conditions
description: A routine ISS maintenance EVA is scheduled. Conditions are quiet with no active storms, but a small M-class flare occurred 12 hours ago. Should the EVA proceed as planned?
historicalOutcome: This is a constructed 'quiet but tempting' scenario. The M-class flare was minor and occurred hours ago with no associated CME. The EVA would proceed normally.
